storage.ready: Local storage is ready on this browser.
storage.offlineReady: The application is ready for offline use on this browser.
storage.blocked: Local storage is waiting for another tab. Close other Benchline Stats tabs and app windows to allow initialization to continue.
storage.closed: Local storage was closed, possibly by an update in another tab. Reload when you are ready, or try opening storage again. Existing data has not been reset.
storage.unsupported: Local storage is unavailable in this browser. Use a browser that supports IndexedDB and allows site storage.
storage.failed: Local storage could not be initialized. Check available space and this browser's site-storage settings, then try again. Existing data has not been reset.

persistence.persistent: Persistent storage is enabled. Clearing site data or losing this device can still remove local records.
persistence.bestEffort: Persistent storage was not granted. Local storage works, but this browser may remove it when space is low.
persistence.unsupported: This browser cannot request persistent storage. Local storage works, but the browser manages how long it is retained.
persistence.failed: Persistent storage could not be checked or requested. Local storage works, but protection against browser eviction is unconfirmed.
